These are the valid codes for Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.8; for upcoming snapshots, see [Pre-release protocol#Entity Metadata](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/Pre-release_protocol#Entity_Metadata "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/Pre-release protocol").

This page is maintained semi-automatically using a work-in-progress script made by mat, so it should update fairly quickly to new Minecraft versions. Regardless, it's not recommended that you parse it programmatically. Instead, consider using Bixilon's [PixLyzer](https://gitlab.bixilon.de/bixilon/pixlyzer) or [Burger](https://github.com/Pokechu22/Burger) (or [mat's Burger fork](https://github.com/mat-1/Burger), which the script for updating this page depends on).

These entity IDs are up to date for 1.21.8. Use [Data Generators](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/Data_Generators "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/Data Generators") or [Burger](https://pokechu22.github.io/Burger/) to get older IDs. If using Burger just replace the version number to what you want to see.

Most entities are spawned via [Protocol#Spawn Entity](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/Protocol#Spawn_Entity "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/Protocol"), however, care should be taken for the following cases:

Entities marked in \_\_ blue must be spawned in their own special ways:

- `Experience Orb`, should be spawned using [Spawn Experience Orb](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/Protocol#Spawn_Experience_Orb "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/Protocol")

Entities marked in \_\_ red must not be spawned at all, as they're server-side only:

- `Marker`, more info can be found [here](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Marker "Marker").

## Entity Metadata Format

Note that entity metadata is a totally distinct concept from block metadata. It is not required to send all metadata fields, or even any metadata fields, so long as the terminating entry is correctly sent.

Entity Metadata is an array of entries, each of which looks like the following:

| Name | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Index | [Unsigned Byte](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Unsigned_Byte "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | Unique index key determining the meaning of the following value, see the table below. If this is `0xff` then the it is the end of the Entity Metadata array and no more is read. |
| Type | [VarInt](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:VarInt "Java Edition protocol/Data types") [Enum](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Enum "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | Only if Index is not `0xff`; the type of the index, see the table below |
| Value | Varies | Only if Index is not `0xff`: the value of the metadata field, see the table below |

| Type | Name | Value | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | [Byte](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:Byte) | [Byte](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Byte "Java Edition protocol/Data types") |  |
| 1 | [VarInt](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:VarInt) | [VarInt](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:VarInt "Java Edition protocol/Data types") |  |
| 2 | [VarLong](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:VarLong) | [VarLong](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:VarLong "Java Edition protocol/Data types") |  |
| 3 | [Float](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:Float) | [Float](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Float "Java Edition protocol/Data types") |  |
| 4 | [String](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:String) | [String](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:String "Java Edition protocol/Data types") (32767) |  |
| 5 | [Text Component](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:Text_Component) | [Text Component](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Text_Component "Java Edition protocol/Data types") |  |
| 6 | [Optional Text Component](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:Optional_Text_Component) | ([Boolean](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Boolean "Java Edition protocol/Data types"), [Optional](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Optional "Java Edition protocol/Data types") [Text Component](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Text_Component "Java Edition protocol/Data types")) | Text Component is present if the Boolean is set to true. |
| 7 | [Slot](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:Slot) | [Slot](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Slot "Java Edition protocol/Data types") |  |
| 8 | [Boolean](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:Boolean) | [Boolean](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Boolean "Java Edition protocol/Data types") |  |
| 9 | [Rotations](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:Rotations) | ([Float](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Float "Java Edition protocol/Data types"), [Float](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Float "Java Edition protocol/Data types"), [Float](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Float "Java Edition protocol/Data types")) | rotation on x, rotation on y, rotation on z |
| 10 | [Position](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:Position) | [Position](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Position "Java Edition protocol/Data types") |  |
| 11 | [Optional Position](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:Optional_Position) | ([Boolean](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Boolean "Java Edition protocol/Data types"), [Optional](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Optional "Java Edition protocol/Data types") [Position](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Position "Java Edition protocol/Data types")) | Position is present if the Boolean is set to true. |
| 12 | [Direction](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:Direction) | [VarInt](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:VarInt "Java Edition protocol/Data types") [Enum](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Enum "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | Down = 0, Up = 1, North = 2, South = 3, West = 4, East = 5 |
| 13 | [Optional Living Entity Reference](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:Optional_Living_Entity_Reference) | ([Boolean](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Boolean "Java Edition protocol/Data types"), [Optional](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Optional "Java Edition protocol/Data types") [UUID](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:UUID "Java Edition protocol/Data types")) | UUID is present if the Boolean is set to true. |
| 14 | [Block State](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:Block_State) | [VarInt](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:VarInt "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | An ID in the block state registry. |
| 15 | [Optional Block State](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:Optional_Block_State) | [VarInt](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:VarInt "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | 0 for absent (air is unrepresentable); otherwise, an ID in the block state registry. |
| 16 | [NBT](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:NBT) | [NBT](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:NBT "Java Edition protocol/Data types") |  |
| 17 | [Particle](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:Particle) | ([VarInt](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:VarInt "Java Edition protocol/Data types"), Varies) | particle type (an ID in the `minecraft:particle_type` registry), particle data (See [Particles](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Minecraft_Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg_merge/Particles "Minecraft Wiki:Projects/wiki.vg merge/Particles").) |
| 18 | [Particles](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:Particles) | ([VarInt](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:VarInt "Java Edition protocol/Data types"), [Array](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Array "Java Edition protocol/Data types") of ([VarInt](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:VarInt "Java Edition protocol/Data types"), Varies)) | length-prefixed list of particle defintions (as above). |
| 19 | [Villager Data](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:Villager_Data) | ([VarInt](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:VarInt "Java Edition protocol/Data types"), [VarInt](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:VarInt "Java Edition protocol/Data types"), [VarInt](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:VarInt "Java Edition protocol/Data types")) | villager type, villager profession, level (See below.) |
| 20 | [Optional VarInt](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:Optional_VarInt) | [VarInt](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:VarInt "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | 0 for absent; 1 + actual value otherwise. Used for entity IDs. |
| 21 | [Pose](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:Pose) | [VarInt](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:VarInt "Java Edition protocol/Data types") [Enum](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Enum "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | STANDING = 0, FALL\_FLYING = 1, SLEEPING = 2, SWIMMING = 3, SPIN\_ATTACK = 4, SNEAKING = 5, LONG\_JUMPING = 6, DYING = 7, CROAKING = 8, USING\_TONGUE = 9, SITTING = 10, ROARING = 11, SNIFFING = 12, EMERGING = 13, DIGGING = 14, (1.21.3: SLIDING = 15, SHOOTING = 16, INHALING = 17) |
| 22 | [Cat Variant](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:Cat_Variant) | [VarInt](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:VarInt "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | An ID in the `minecraft:cat_variant` registry. |
| 23 | [Cow Variant](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:Cow_Variant) | [VarInt](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:VarInt "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | An ID in the `minecraft:cow_variant` registry. |
| 24 | [Wolf Variant](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:Wolf_Variant) | [VarInt](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:VarInt "Java Edition protocol/Data types") | An ID in the `minecraft:wolf_variant` registry. |

| 29 | [Optional Global Position](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:Optional_Global_Position) | ([Boolean](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Boolean "Java Edition protocol/Data types"), [Optional](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Optional "Java Edition protocol/Data types") [Identifier](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Identifier "Java Edition protocol/Data types"), [Optional](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Optional "Java Edition protocol/Data types") [Position](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_protocol/Data_types#Type:Position "Java Edition protocol/Data types")) | dimension identifier, position; only if the Boolean is set to true. |

Entity classes also recursively inherit fields from classes they extend.

## Entity Metadata

### Entity

The base class.

| Index | Type | Meaning | | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | [Byte (0)](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:Byte) | Bit mask | Meaning | 0 |
| 0x01 | Is on fire |
| 0x02 | Is pressing sneak key (hides the name tag, but does not make the entity visually sneak.) |
| 0x04 | *Unused* (previously riding) |
| 0x08 | Is sprinting (shows sprinting particles when on ground.) |
| 0x10 | Is swimming |
| 0x20 | Is invisible |
| 0x40 | has glowing effect |
| 0x80 | Is flying with an [elytra](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Elytra "Elytra") |
| 1 | [VarInt (1)](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:VarInt) | Air ticks | | 300 |
| 2 | [Optional Text Component (6)](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:Optional_Text_Component) | Custom name | | empty |
| 3 | [Boolean (8)](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:Boolean) | Is custom name visible | | false |
| 4 | [Boolean (8)](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:Boolean) | Is silent | | false |
| 5 | [Boolean (8)](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:Boolean) | Has no gravity | | false |
| 6 | [Pose (21)](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:Pose) | Pose | | STANDING |
| 7 | [VarInt (1)](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:VarInt) | Ticks frozen in powder snow | | 0 |

On the Notchan server Is pressing sneak key reflects the sneak key state indicated by the client rather than the entity's pose, and can thus be set while swimming, flying or crawling, or unset while stuck sneaking under a block.

Freezing ticks cap at 140 in the client for the player's snow overlay when stuck in powder snow. If the entity extends LivingEntity and freezing ticks reaches the cap, the mob will start shaking (this excludes the skeleton, which has its own indicator).

### Ender Dragon

Extends [Mob](https://minecraft.wiki#Mob).

| Index | Type | Meaning | | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 16 | [VarInt (1)](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:VarInt) | Dragon phase | | 10 (hover) |

Phases (according to [the wiki page on dragon data values](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Ender_Dragon#Data_values "Ender Dragon")) are:

- 0: circling
- 1: strafing (preparing to shoot a fireball)
- 2: flying to the portal to land (part of transition to landed state)
- 3: landing on the portal (part of transition to landed state)
- 4: taking off from the portal (part of transition out of landed state)
- 5: landed, performing breath attack
- 6: landed, looking for a player for breath attack
- 7: landed, roar before beginning breath attack
- 8: charging player
- 9: flying to portal to die
- 10: hovering with no AI (default when using the /summon command).

### Pig

Extends [Animal](https://minecraft.wiki#Animal).

| Index | Type | Meaning | | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 17 | [VarInt (1)](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:VarInt) | Total time to "boost" with a carrot on a stick for | | 0 |

Whenever a carrot on a stick is used, if the pig is not currently boosting it will start to boost for 140 to 980 (inclusive) ticks. When boost time is changed, a counter is reset which counts up to the boost time, after which boosting will stop. The value remains set at its modified value even after boosting is stopped.

### Abstract Minecart

Extends [Abstract Vehicle](https://minecraft.wiki#Abstract_Vehicle).

| Index | Type | Meaning | | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 11 | [Optional Block State (15)](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:Optional_Block_State) | Custom block state | | 0 |
| 12 | [VarInt (1)](https://minecraft.wiki#Metadata_type:VarInt) | Custom block Y position (in 16ths of a block) | | 6 |

If custom block state is unset, then each type of Minecart will render its own type of block with its own properties. Note that one does *not* need to send these values for the metadata fields, as the client will automatically select them if they are not overridden by the metadata field. They are only provided for reference to help with swapping out other blocks.

- Rideable Minecarts contain air (`minecraft:air`) and have a y position of 6
- Chest Minecarts contain chests facing north (`minecraft:chest[facing=north]`) and have a y position of 8
- Furnace Minecarts contain a normal furnace facing north when unpowered (`minecraft:furnace[facing=north]`) and a lit furnace facing north when powered (`minecraft:furnace[facing=north, lit=true]`) and have a y position of 6 in both cases
- Hopper Minecarts contain a hopper (`minecraft:hopper`) and have a y position of 1
- TNT Minecarts contain TNT (`minecraft:tnt`) and have a y position of 6
- Command block minecarts contain a Command Block (`minecraft:command_block`) and have a y position of 6
- Spawner Minecarts contain a spawner (`minecraft:spawner`) and have a y position of 6
